contracts.docstring: Locate at most four internal frames per cause and four causes, excluding messages, filesystem paths, source lines and locals.

One externally supplied, non-reused domain for one original attempt.

``run_peer`` owns reserve→spawn→global publication→concrete local bind→G.
Callers receive a transport only after G and can only recover a receipt on
retry. ``revoke`` withdraws G before waiting for SQL/constructors. Global
recovery needs only the journal/domain, never the original project DB.
Complete actor-origin and endpoint authentication remain deployment work.
Witness launch intent before its original gate; retain safe startup locations after physical closure even when withdrawal replaces the outward error.
A withdrawn real pre-gate namespace retains safe original diagnostics before its public conflict suppresses that cause.
Require physical retirement before operator logging can perform any I/O.
Inject an original namespace observation failure alongside a real owner withdrawal, before any gate is sent.
An unavailable log sink preserves the original startup exception and observes a closed real pre-gate domain.
Fail before native code can receive a gate; the error message is synthetic and private.
Simulate a broken operator sink after physical retirement instead of granting logging authority over Stop.

scope: New/changed Python definitions and modules in this delivery. New frontend modules and exported behavior have English JSDoc; this Python audit does not certify all historical definitions.
